business_summary: Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited, through its subsidiaries, operates as a construction engineering business in China and internationally. The company engages in the infrastructure activity of buildings, bridge buildings, hotels and commercial buildings, and cultural and sports buildings; public transportation engineering; underground space development; landscaping engineering; industrial construction; and environmental protection engineering and other fields. It is also involved the foundation engineering, structure, roofing engineering, and decoration engineering construction; investment in land and real estate development; real estate management and acquisition; and architectural design business, as well as business of logistics, financial, prefabricated building, and new building material industries. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Xi'an, China. Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited is a subsidiary of Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited는 자회사를 통해 중국 및 해외에서 건설 엔지니어링 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 건물, 교량 건물, 호텔 및 상업용 건물, 문화 및 스포츠 건물의 인프라 활동에 참여합니다. 대중교통공학; 지하공간개발; 조경공학; 산업 건설; 환경 보호 공학 및 기타 분야. 또한 기초 엔지니어링, 구조, 지붕 엔지니어링 및 장식 엔지니어링 건설도 포함됩니다. 토지 및 부동산 개발에 대한 투자; 부동산 관리 및 취득; 건축설계사업, 물류, 금융, 조립식 건축, 신건자재 산업 등의 사업을 하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 1950년에 설립되었으며 중국 시안(Xi'an)에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 산시건설공정그룹주식유한회사(Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited)는 산시건설공정그룹유한회사(Shaanxi Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd.)의 자회사입니다.
